privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: Zukkolab stores your name and phone number only to contact you and arrange your trial lesson.
privacy.p2: We never sell or share your data with third parties. If you sign up via Telegram, we store your chat ID to send reminders.
privacy.p3: To delete your data, contact any branch or our Telegram bot — we'll delete it within 3 business days.
privacy.p4: This is a demo site: any data entered here is used for demonstration only and is cleared regularly.
